第十八章 药剂风暴
淡淡的清香在药剂室里弥漫，烧杯中的药剂正发出“咕隆咕隆”的声响。
林立一边往烧杯中添加宁神花汁液，一边细心计算着三种药水的比重，这中间他只是偶尔抬手擦去额头上的汗水，很快又埋下头去继续忙碌。
而在他身后，是一瓶瓶配好的奥法药剂。
中间葛瑞安又过来关心了几次，在看到这一瓶瓶奥法药剂的时候，胖老头差点没把舌头给咬掉，本来不看都已经惦记上了，这下看到了就更不得了了，老家伙就象是饥渴了几十年的久旷怨妇似的，死活赖在药剂室里不肯走，非要林立给他弄两瓶尝尝不可。
林立好说歹说，最后还是弄了一瓶，总算把这老怨妇给打发走了。
除了老怨妇之外，凯文也过来看了几次。
不过比起胖老头来，这年轻法师可就老实多了，进门跟林立打过招呼之后，就老老实实的蹲在墙角画圈圈，遇到有事的时候，还能帮林立打打下手，所求的也不过是见识一下药剂大师的技艺。
数千金币的草药，搞了差不多足有一周。
到周三的时候，林立才拖着疲惫的身体从药剂室出来。
从药剂室出来之后，林立又第一时间找到了葛瑞安，一老一少再次躲进会客室里，谈了差不多有大半个下午，两人才带着一脸的奸笑从里面出来。
干完这一切，林立终于是可以睡个好觉了。
这么多天忙下来，林立早就累得头晕眼花，此时一觉睡下去，直接就睡到了周五早上。
等到他这一觉睡醒的时候，一条消息早在加洛斯城内传得沸沸扬扬。
“据说前不久的时候，加洛斯魔法公会发现了一个高等精灵遗迹，从里面弄到了很多的大师级药水！”
“不对不对，我听说是他们挖到了一个药剂大师，这回魔法公会真是可发了，听说那药剂大师不但人被挖来了，还从药剂师公会里带了一批药剂出来！”
“你就吹吧，魔法公会这几年是个什么光景，大家谁不知道？药剂师公会那些家伙，可个个都是眼睛长在头顶上的，他们要能挖来药剂师，我就能把翡翠高塔塔尖给啃掉！”
“真不知道他们是怎么想的，那可是大师级的药剂，不自己藏着悄悄喝也就算了，居然还拿出来卖！妈的……你们几个别走，把钱都拿出来先借给我，老子也买一瓶去！”
“你少做梦了！就我们几个这点钱，加起来还不够买只瓶子的，恩，买个瓶盖可能够了……”
而这一切的来源，只是因为葛瑞安的一句话。

“本周日，魔法公会将在翡翠高塔内拍卖三十瓶奥法药剂！”
加洛斯的法师们都不记得，自己有多少年没听过“奥法药剂”这个名字了，特别是属于魔法家族的那些。
加洛斯魔法公会这几年虽然落魄，但因为黑暗年代时的协议，他们多多少少还能从药剂师公会搞到一些援助，虽然这种援助，通常都是用葛瑞安那张老脸去换来的，但比起魔法家族来，他们仍然是幸福的。
魔法家族拥有庞大的财富，也拥有令人眼红的权势，可药剂师公会又岂是财富和权势所能打动的？
任何一个药剂师，都拥有藐视这一切的资格。
他们传承自高等精灵王朝的技艺，本身就是这世界上最珍贵的财富，如果一个药剂大师愿意的话，他翻手之间就能轻易让一个魔法家族覆灭，这世界上有太多的强者愿意为一瓶药剂赴汤蹈火。
大概也只有梅林家族这种庞然大物，才有那么一点点机会获得大师级药剂，不过也仅仅是一点点而已……
自从葛瑞安放出话来之后，整个加洛斯城就彻底轰动了。
有资格竞争的势力，都在争先恐后的捞钱。
对这三十瓶奥法药剂势在必得的梅林家族，甚至不惜处理了几处位于加洛斯城中心的房产，为的就是能在竞争中多一点筹码，毕竟葛瑞安那老家伙已经说了，这一次加洛斯魔法公会只认钱，谁出的价格最高，谁就最有机会，交情什么的，等把东西卖完了再谈！
据说就连老奥丁找上门去，葛瑞安都给他碰了个钉子，整个加洛斯城谁不知道，这两个老家伙是穿一条裤子的？听说连老奥丁都碰了钉子，梅林家族刚要伸出去示好的手，顿时又收了回来……
“城中心那几处房产，处理得怎么样了？”马修斯－梅林今年五十三岁，担任梅林家族这一代的族长已经十年，可他却很少象今天这么激动过，今天之内，他已经在客厅里走了不知道多少个来回，踩在那柔软的地毯上，心情却久久无法平复。
三十瓶奥法药剂，对于梅林家族来说，简直就是天赐的良机。
他还从来没有见过，有哪个势力一次拿出这么多的奥法药剂，就连药剂师公会，也从来没这么大手笔过，在听到这个消息的时候，向来喜怒不形于色的马修斯－梅林，当场就激动得将手里的酒杯给摔了。
那可是三十瓶奥法药剂，意味着三十次永久提升魔力的机会。
虽然这个机会仅仅是针对五级以下的魔法师，但梅林家族最多的，不也正是五级以下的魔法师吗？
五级对大多数魔法师来说，都是一道难以跨越的鸿沟。
跨越了这道鸿沟，便有资格穿上长长的法师袍，被人称为“尊敬的魔法师先生”，但若是跨不过去，就终身只是一个可怜的魔法学徒。
魔法师与魔法学徒，一步天堂，一步地狱……
以梅林家族如今的势力，若是再突然多出三十名五级以上的魔法师来……想到这里，马修斯仿佛看到了家族辉煌的未来……

你们太厉害了，下午打个滚，晚上就上榜了。
我一定努力多码字，多更新来报答各位恩公！

Chapter 18 Potion Storm
A faint fragrance filled the pharmacy room, and the medicine in the beaker was making a "rumbling" sound.
Lin Li added the Ningshen Flower juice to the beaker and carefully calculated the proportions of the three potions. During this period, he only occasionally raised his hand to wipe the sweat from his forehead, and then quickly lowered his head and continued working.
Behind him are bottles of prepared arcane potions.
In the meantime, Grean came over to pay attention to them a few times. When he saw the bottles of arcane potion, the fat old man almost bit off his tongue. He was already thinking about it without looking at it, but now he saw it.
Lin Li talked hard and finally got a bottle and finally sent the old resentful woman away.
In addition to the old resentful woman, Kevin also came to visit several times.
However, compared to the fat old man, this young mage was much more honest. After greeting Lin Li after entering the door, he squatted in the corner and drew circles. When something happened, he could help Lin Li. All he wanted was to see the skills of the pharmacist master.
It took almost a full week to make the herbal medicine worth thousands of gold coins.
On Wednesday, Lin Li dragged his exhausted body out of the pharmacy.
After coming out of the pharmacy, Lin Li immediately found Greg. The old man and the young man hid in the reception room again. After talking for most of the afternoon, the two came out with evil smiles on their faces.
After doing all this, Lin Li could finally have a good sleep.
After so many days of work, Lin Li was already dizzy from exhaustion. At this time, he fell asleep and slept until Friday morning.
When he woke up from his sleep, a piece of news had spread throughout the city of Garros.
"It is said that not long ago, the Garros Magic Guild discovered a high elf ruins and obtained a lot of master-level potions from it!"
"No, no, I heard that they poached a potion master. This time the Magic Guild is really doing something great. I heard that not only was the potion master poached, but he also brought a batch of potions from the Pharmacist Guild!"
"Just brag. Who doesn't know what the Magic Guild has been like these past few years? Those guys from the Pharmacist Guild all have eyes on the top of their heads. If they can poach the pharmacists, I can chew off the spire of the Emerald Tower!"
"I really don't know what they think. It's a master-level potion. It's okay not to hide it and drink it secretly, but it's actually sold! Damn... you guys don't leave, take out all your money and lend it to me first. I'll buy a bottle too!"
"Stop dreaming! The little money we have together is not enough to buy a bottle. Well, maybe we can buy a bottle cap..."
And the source of all this is just a word from Grean.
"This Sunday, the Magic Guild will auction thirty bottles of arcane potions in the Emerald Tower!"
None of the mages in Garros remember how many years they have not heard the name "Arcane Potion", especially those belonging to magic families.
Although the Garros Magic Guild has been in decline in recent years, because of the agreement in the Dark Ages, they can still get some assistance from the Apothecary Guild. Although this assistance is usually obtained in exchange for Gray's old face, compared to the Magic Family, they are still happy.
The magic family has huge wealth and enviable power, but how can the Pharmacist Guild be moved by wealth and power?
Any pharmacist has the qualification to despise all of this.
The skills they inherited from the High Elf Dynasty are themselves the most precious wealth in the world. If a potion master is willing, he can easily destroy a magic family with just a few clicks. There are too many in this world.Many strong men are willing to go through fire and water for a bottle of potion.
Probably only a behemoth like the Merlin family has a slight chance of obtaining a master-level potion, but only a little...
Ever since Grean's words came out, the entire city of Garros was completely in a state of shock.
The forces that are qualified to compete are scrambling to make money.
The Merlin family, who was determined to get these thirty bottles of arcane potions, even did not hesitate to dispose of several properties in the center of Garros City, in order to gain more chips in the competition. After all, the old guy Grian had already said that this time the Garros Magic Guild only recognized money. Whoever paid the highest price would have the best chance. We can talk about friendship and other things after the things are sold out!
It is said that even when old Odin came to his door, Grean gave him a hard time. Who in the entire city of Garros didn't know that these two old guys were wearing the same pair of pants? I heard that even old Odin was in trouble. Just when the Merlin family was about to extend their hand to show their kindness, they immediately took it back...
"How are the properties in the center of the city being handled?" Matthews Merlin is fifty-three years old this year and has been the patriarch of the Merlin family for ten years. However, he has rarely been as excited as today. Today, he has walked back and forth in the living room countless times, stepping on the soft carpet, but his mood has been unable to calm down for a long time.
Thirty bottles of arcane potions are simply a God-given opportunity for the Merlin family.
He had never seen any force produce so many arcane potions at one time, and even the Pharmacists Guild had never done so with such a large amount. When he heard the news, Matthews Merlin, who had always kept his emotions secret, was so excited that he dropped the wine glass in his hand.
Those are thirty bottles of arcane potion, which means thirty opportunities to permanently increase magic power.
Although this opportunity is only for magicians below level five, isn't it true that the Merlin family has the most magicians below level five?
Level five is a gap that is difficult to cross for most magicians.
If you cross this gap, you will be qualified to wear the long mage robe and be called "respected Mr. Magician". However, if you cannot cross this gap, you will only be a poor magic apprentice for life.
The magician and the magic apprentice, one step to heaven, one step to hell...
With the current power of the Merlin family, if there were suddenly 30 more magicians of level five or above... Thinking of this, Matthews seemed to see the glorious future of the family...
You guys are so awesome. If you roll around in the afternoon, you will be on the list in the evening.
I will definitely try my best to write more words and update more to repay all my benefactors!
